subject: english
stem: The speakers are checking a plan together. Which detail is given in the conversation?
options: the folding chairs must reach the art room before four o'clock
the sports cones must reach the community hall before four o'clock
the folding chairs must reach the community hall before nine fifteen
the folding chairs must reach the community hall before four o'clock

the sports cones must reach the community hall before four o'clock：此項把「folding chairs」改成「sports cones」。對話明確陳述「the folding chairs must reach the community hall before four o'clock」。因此，鎖定證據支持「the folding chairs must reach the community hall before four o'clock」。

the folding chairs must reach the community hall before nine fifteen：此項把「four o'clock」改成「nine fifteen」。對話明確陳述「the folding chairs must reach the community hall before four o'clock」。因此，鎖定證據支持「the folding chairs must reach the community hall before four o'clock」。
the folding chairs must reach the community hall before four o'clock：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。對話明確陳述「the folding chairs must reach the community hall before four o'clock」。
